title: Castaway Resultant Displacement
body: A castaway on a raft is blown in seven legs: (1) $$2.50\, \text{km}$$ at 45° north of west, (2) $$4.70\, \text{km}$$ at 60° south of east, (3) $$1.30\, \text{km}$$ at 25° south of west, (4) $$5.10\, \text{km}$$ due east, (5) $$1.70\, \text{km}$$ at 5° east of north, (6) $$7.20\, \text{km}$$ at 55° south of west, (7) $$2.80\, \text{km}$$ at 10° north of east. Find the magnitude and direction of the resultant displacement.
